classes.RESTRICTED_HELDOUT_OBSERVATION: observation-level held-out content; the dashboard only reports its existence
classes.PROTECTED_PRODUCTION: reserved for protected production evaluations; no such record exists in this repository
classes.UNCLASSIFIED: not in this map; treated as unverified until curated
